column1: review

Unbelievably laggier and laggier as you go deeper into menus. Each menu adding more lag than the last. Whoever optimized this app is trash. Been doing this for well over a year now and no fix to be seen. Borderline unusable except for front page actions. And I have a Z Fold 5, which is more than enough computing power to run the app.

Edited from prev versions: It's a decent app. I can download and check storage space on my ps5 away from my console. The messaging had fallen through though. I get one notification out of 10 of the messages I get. 2025 Edit: decent app, the store really needs improvement. We should be able to see what a game is rated, that usually influences my purchase.

Most things it does fine, checking trophies, recent games, etc. But the problem lies with the captures from the media gallery. No matter how long or short it is, the video lags the entire phone, even outside the app. If you turn off your phone, the videos don't download. It's gotten so bad that just before, trying to download a 30-second clip somehow restarted my phone. It shouldn't be such a hassle, since this is supposedly the most convenient way to share clips. This should be fixed.

Could use some work. Uploaded 2 files (a video clip and a screenshot), both did not appear in the app. The app is just as bad as PS direct using the Firefox browser, but at least I can navigate the browser by clearing the cache and history for the website if I want to use Firefox-- so forget trying to pay through the app. I love Sony Playstation, but wish they would get the supervising parties to fix the app and the issues involving using certain web browsers.

This app has some annoying bugs... It will repeat notification on me randomly during the day or night. I have to set restrictions on the app so that it doesn't beep all night or while I'm at work. The UI is slow and unresponsive at times, and messages are delayed a little. Things I like: being able to shop for games, being able to join a party chat via my phone. Being able to watch share streams from my phone. Being able to message people from my phone. Rated 2/5... Due to bugs and slowness.

Honestly I don't mind about everything else. My only issue is the captures in my library of media. I want to be able to download videos, but instead it continues to say "can't download, try again later." For the past 5 million tries. And not only that, but it also takes forever to load. And the video frame rate is so twitchy. I just want to download videos man.

Ordinarily this app does what it's supposed to do and works great but recently, around the first week of October, my app just stopped working. I don't mean there's an error message or some features aren't working, it straight up stopped working. I'll press the app icon on my home screen, it'll show the blue backsplash like it's opening, then just stops. Instant crash. I'm using Android, I've cleared the cache, managed memory, reinstalled, nothing works. It's a shame, I used this all the time.

All things considered, it's a fine mobile hub for Playstation owners. When it works. But it is unbearably slow. It can only load the bare minimum before tapping out when trying to load you library, captures, even your profile, and other things. It's a roll of the dice everytime I open it to wanna check/download my clips and screenshots, sometimes it works, often times it doesn't.

App has been going into shambles. First the app would crash when I tried downloading clips. Then when I clip a 15 second video, uploading it would make my ping from 15 to 500+. Not only that but I can even turn the settings off on mobile because the app crashes as soon as I open it. They need to fix this, it's been like this for me for probably 4 months now. It's not a wifi problem either for those wondering. I've checked with different wifi providers and wired connection.

Needs a faster rotation of games in the rewards catalogue, same games for months. I understand it takes some people longer to accumulate points, but now points only stay for a period of time and not forever. Only the $5 gift card shows up when redeeming points.... Cannot upload a 4K video from the console to the app, but it allows a 4K video on the console to be sent in a message and then it appears on the app... App no longer allows videos from messages to be downloaded onto a device. 👎👎

I genuinely love the app, its the way i share my clips and brag to my friends on how i hit a quadruple flip reset double tap on rocket league with a gt3 rs, and its a way to communicate to friends, and lastly downloading games to the playstation... although i do wish i could do that without turning it on. Other than that, the app is pretty decent! ＼(^-^)／

Nothing but issues and disappointments with this app! I hoped the problem was me using an outdate phone with Android 9. Now I have a new phone and the app works worse than before! Now when I try to use voice to text, the microphone cuts off the instant I press it. On my old phone I could at least send a message by voice. This is so annoying. There appears no way to repor these problems to anyone and I doubt Sony even cares.

Glad that I'm able to easily download my clips, but there are some issues with the app. While playing clips, it's incredibly hard to move the bar (video progress) back without scrolling to the next clip instead. The pause and play button are also mostly blocked so it's hard to press it when you need to. I also wish that when you paused the video, there wasn't a big play button in the middle that you can't get rid of

U need to add an option if the game is for PS4 or ps5. I accidentally bought the wrong version and it is very difficult and unfriendly to communicate with whoever in charge of refund. yes some games do indicate it's for PS4 but there are games that by default is for ps5 even though it says it can be played on PS4. hope u can look into this.

As of October 23, the app has simply stopped working. Whenever I try to open the app, it simply closes or tells me that it has stopped working. I have tried to reinstall, clear the cache, and reset my phone but, it has not resolved the issue at all. How can an app simply cease to function within the course of a day? And near a date of urgency with people needing to accept new terms for the PlayStation Stars service.

App straight-up no longer works; stone wall crashes upon opening, guaranteed. Cleared cache, deleted and reinstalled, restarted phone; even checked the PSN server page even though I have the feeling that page has never actually been reliable. I've never before in my life had an app that can't even boot up in the first place – which must be embarrassing! How does a perfectly functioning app just brick itself overnight?!

Removal of store credit option for playstation star members??? The playstation stars program is only available on mobile so removing the main feature of the rewards program is unacceptable. Alongside the fact the app no longer works correctly on android, slowing down, crashing, unable to view screenshots from other games unless you open the game and screenshot. scrolling through the saved screenshots causes the app to crash if there are video clips saved due to autoplay and can't disable it.

UI/UX for trying to enter payment info is terrible; you can't even see what you're typing at the bottom of the page (DO YOU EVEN TEST DISPLAY AND UX ON MOBILE?) Listings: There is also missing listing info from what's on the console store, which itself is disappointing since you can't search by developer or publisher. Also, the trailers are all muted, even if you just unmuted and watched another. Swiping media on listings doesn't work properly (extremely bad code.)

Update - 3weeks of not working, no contact from anyone. Nov 14, 2024 Keeps auto crashing, I uninstalled, update, clear storage, etc, still can't get in. Sent in a ticket and still haven't heard back. But I keep getting emails about updating to stars or whatever, that's in the app. That I can't get into. Oct 28th 2024

I've had this app for a while now. And all the sudden my app crashes when opening. Even the the notification shows up and I have the ability to reply, it won't send the reply. I'm not sure what needs to happen to fix the issue but it's infuriating to know I can't get on the app of the company I pay monthly.

i only use this app for downloading my screenshots, and it used to work, even though it was a bit slow to download. now it cuts off every screenshot i try to download in half or just completely unable to see the screenshot. i am very disappointed in this app. i've only experienced this bug since the update in November.

Note/question for developer, Not an entire review: My ps app keeps closing on me as it begins to load up. I've already uninstalled and reinstalled. Perhaps it's just that the Internet connection is not "S Tier" at the moment. I'll change this later if that's the case, but is there anything else that could do that?

The app, is overall okay. My biggest issue is that it constantly turns off my mobile data while I'm in the party talking to my friends. I have no idea how it even has access to do that. My phone will have no network service for a solid 15 minutes. As a doordash and uber driver, this is vital and truly concerning when im in the middle of an order and my network completely goes out. Please fix this issue. Please.

Complicated and frustrating to use. Also, supposedly PayPal is allowed but won't actually let me add it as a payment method. And if you're going to end a sale on a day, make it a reasonable time bc "ends 11/7" with "2am" in the fine details is misleading. At that point just end it the day before at midnight. Who the hell can buy a game at 2 in the morning? That's a ridiculous time.

The recent update to the microphone permissions is causing the party to end when the device leaves the app or turns off. Sometimes, the party continues to operate for a minute or two before ending. It appears that the update is causing this issue, as the device works fine when the older update is downloaded. Please fix this issue. Thank you. Also please stop this update I keep getting it updated to s23 ultra it's affecting me using background apps

Idk what it is. I'm guessing it's a new update of some sort. Every time my screen times out, the people in my party can no longer hear me. It kicks me out of the party over and over again, saying I have a "network error" even though my internet will be working perfectly fine. Also this has been an issue with Playstation for a while, but it gets annoying not being able to delete numerous logged parties that just build up on app and on Playstation.

My party chat is not working properly. It doesn't matter if I'm using Bluetooth earbuds, or my phone's speaker. Once my screen times out or I lock my screen, no one in the party can hear me anymore. Not until I open my screen back up to the app. It is even kicking me due to "networking error" some of the times too. Even though my Internet is strong and working for everything else including my partner on their PS5. I have tried uninstalling and reinstalling. As well as clearing cache.

Latest update ruined the app. After the update, the app loses the microphone input, during party chats, when the screen turns off. How this update went out, untested, is beyond my understanding... Update: Under the new update, I can also no longer sign into the android app. I can sign into the PlayStation console and website, but cannot log back into the app.

The fact that the app is supposed to make things easier to share but it has taken HOURS for a 20 second clip to "download" to the app. Restarting both devices, tried refreshing and it's STILL LOADING. Absolutely useless until this gets fixed. The Playstation is easier to navigate and use than this absolute joke of an app.

I use the app to download clips of my game play for my TikTok. The videos barely ever show up, and when they do, the app for some reason is now in able to download them. I enjoy the app due to it's easy to navigate interface, but the fact that I can't view or download my videos to my phone makes it unbearable. Please find a way to resolve this issue.

Used to love this app. Have made literally hundreds of purchases, as well as had countless parties with friends via the PlayStation app. These past couple months, EVERY single time I open the app, it immediately crashes with no error code. Simply "The Application Has Closed" pops up as soon as the app launches. Support has been 0 help. I've been a PlayStation customer since I was a child during the PS1 era, and this is just frustrating to me.

As of recently when in parties on the app it just makes me mute to my friends after x amount of time, and being a pc player the app is for the most part how I communicate with my ps4/ps5 buddies. Needs some serious fixing because in the middle of a match it's pretty frustrating when it decides to mute me from my friends and I have to go and fix it manually every 10 minutes. It's absolutely mind boggling and annoying inconvenient.

Used to work fine now I can't even download images or videos off the app despite them being uploaded. Has been broken for over a month now and even though the app has updated multiple times the issue persists. Please release a fix. Note: I've cleared the app cache, reinstalled the app, relinked the app to my PS5 and tried reuploading the captures, none of it did anything to solve the issue.

Every time I join a party chat it kicks me out, saying cannot connect to several people in the party chat and then automatically disconnects me from the party. My internet is fine, I'm able to connect via my PS4 just fine. When I use my phone I can hear people on my party so much better than on my controller. I have uninstalled and reinstalled the app, cleared the data and cleared the cache, and restarted my phone a dozen times. Phone is updated to current Android OS. 😞

I love the design and it seems to run smoother. However, it has lost all usefulness. Every time I try to add a game to my cart, it says that I can't add to cart. I am not a social gamer. I don't use the other features. I, quite literally, only use the app to purchase games without needing to turn my PlayStation on. Since this feature is now broken, this app has become useless. I really enjoy the new look and it runs smoother than before. If it wasn't broken, I would be singing its praise.

Got new phone. This app even worse on new phone. Horrible. When i typing to my friends. Few seconds later. Lagging, freezing also only problem is send and receive. Few of my friends and myself are complaining because sending message are taking long time and sometimes fail to send. Also receive messages are glitch as well. We receive messages on consoles on time. But this app takes forever to receive it. Please fix.

Full transparency, this app is great when it works. I've been using the app for three years and they keep adding new features, it's great. The reason I gave 2 stars is because the last 2 months the app has been saying "who broke the internet? Check internet connection". Can't do anything to fix it. I hope they will fix the bug and I can give it a better review

New app for PS5 addition is clunky. They went for style over functionality. Looks cool but takes more time to use compared to previous version. Also buying 1 game at a time is the 1 thing I hate about Nintendo's eshop...Surprise! Now Sony has added this unnecessary waste of time as well. How exactly is that going to work for Sony's big sales? I hope they fix it. I actually don't mind moving messages back to the main app. However, the app needs a major overhaul when it comes to usability.

*UPDATE 3* Much better, still doesn't show all PlayStation trophies though. *UPDATE 2* This app has become so clunky and slow *UPDATE* Why can I not see all of my PlayStation Trophies through the app. They have completely revamped this app and turned it into what it always should have been. By far, the best app between the console makers. Best experience I've seen. Kinda disappointing to see an entire platform not supported through the "PlayStation App".

1. There's a bug where I can't remove an item from my wishlist if I bought it. 2. We need the option to go directly to a game if we are looking at the add-on, it would be pretty cool if people could write reviews of the games, that way it would be easier to decide if I want to buy a game instead of looking for reviews in Google/steam. Other than that the app has improved and I think it can improve more.

The Playstation App was working great for me for a long time, and now for some reason the Playstation stars feature is gone. When I click where it is SUPPOSED to be, it opens and then quickly closes and gives an error message. I have accrued a lot of points, probably 20-40 Dollars worth. I can't be sure though, as I CAN'T USE THEM. this really does need to be fixed.

I was really enjoying this app, but now it won't let me look at my messages or notifications anymore. Every time I try it says "something went wrong. Try again later". It's been days and still the same error message! I downloaded this app to be able to talk to my friends while not on my system and now it won't let me message any of them or even see the messages we already have going which I know are still there because they show up just fine on my console. Makes the app pointless. PLEASE FIX!

Wow. They really did the pooch on this one. Hands down, it is a very pretty design. No doubt. But the navigation is terrible. Its just horrible. This new app design has about (not even) 1/3 of the original app. There are many, many things (options and navigation tools) that are missing, and one can only hope that Playstation has a lot, I mean....A LOT....of work to do with the new app. You are better off navigating on your PS4. On the bright side, you can see and chat with friends very easy.

The app has great features and would be amazing, if it wasn't one of the slowest, most frustrating things to try to use. I can access my messages faster by walking across the house and waiting for my PlayStation to turn on and connect to the Internet than I can when using the app. It's genuinely one of the slowest, most poorly optimized apps I've ever used. But the features it has are nice. I just wish it worked faster.

Update 11/1/20: I like the way the new app is in a way. I do not like the fact that the store is not the best now. I would be able to navigate threw the store by what was new this week or month. Now I can not. Went for 5 to 2 Origional: I love the fact I can still stay in contact with news feeds and messages. I wish they would make an update to alow push notifications so we know when we get a new message. That would make the app great for any playstation owner.

Okay, the messaging system doesn't work. I mean, it DOES but 80 percent of the time the messages never update and I cannot send anything until it does. I tried to close and reopen the app several times but I cannot use the messaging system whatsoever... Everything else is fine. Hence the 2 stars, but yeah. No. I mainly use this to message peeps on PS4 and now I cannot without actually going on PS4

While I appreciate that the app is more than just a portal to their website (like it was before), it looks like it was designed in 2006. Who thought it was a good idea to drag a panel from the top when phones are so big? Also, it's impossible to message someone without creating a party—that's insane. I don't want to party up with people just because I want to message them.

I miss the old app, mainly because I could "Quick Reply" to messages like a text message without opening the whole app up. Since the update, the app runs slow and I don't see messages sent from friend's. As of today, the app isn't working at all. I get notifications for new messages, but I can't see them on the app on my phone and when I check my PS4, the messages are there and I can see them. Someone really needs to fix this app because this is ridiculous and unfair already. Total nonsense.

I like having the ability to manage the PS remotely and view/respond to messages. What is annoying to me that in the latest update we've lost the ability to see WHEN a particular friend signed on. I don't know from the notification if it was 5 min ago or 5 hours ago. Especially annoying since this functionality existed in previous versions and Sony decided to remove it.

This app is one of, if not the most, sluggish apps I've ever used. Navigating this app is a complete chore because of how unresponsive and slow everything is. Searching up player's names doesn't work half the time, and opening chats will sometimes open the wrong one. Just trying to simply open the app can take a while. You'd think to expect more from a company of this magnitude.

The app isn't that bad, but recently for the past week, whenever I go to check to see who is online, it's tells me that the same people are on, even when I know they're not. The menu has been frozen like that for me for a while. I mainly use the app to see who all is on before I boot up my system, but when the app is so unreliable, it makes it hard to determine if I want to play at all. The app usually helps me coordinate squads for when I want to play R6, CoD, or D2, but no longer works.

I like the app and use it very regularly. Makes it easy to make purchases and manage games on my PS5. Great to get notifications when friends come online and see what they're playing. Can even join chat if I'm not near my PS5. For months now, even after the recent update, I get "Well, that didn't work. Can't load games" over and over and over. Seems to be happening more often than not now. No amount of cache clearing or resetting app or anything seems to fix it.

Joining parties from your phone and saving clips is nice, but this app has some serious issues. Being in a party sometimes glitches, making you unable to mute, leave, and interact with the app, even if you close and reopen it, and the only solution is to power off your phone Something else I find very annoying is that if you close the app, it'll keep you in the party. You can still hear everyone else, and they can also hear you, which I feel like is a big invasion of privacy.

The PlayStation® App allows you you to customize your real name, picture, account background for PS4 and is now recombined with the messaging app (yes I was there for the split) hopefully it continues to take up less overall space as some of us need that. New layout is alright though I'm sure I'm just not used to it yet. The feature to join voice chat is really sweet.

I love the idea of the app. Being able to control my PS5 while not even being home is awesome! There's 2 things I use this app for, 1) Downloading/updating games while I'm away and 2) For messages that are too much to type with a controller. The app is un usable. You'll get about 2 lines of text out before the app freezes and ultimately leads to a crash. Breaks my heart to see such a renowned company, not fix their companion app to the newest generation console there is. 2+ months like this.

I love the app and would rate higher for when it does work for me, but for some reason every month since I got it 1 year ago. I try to login but it just logs me out and won't let me sign back in. I have tried countless things but to no end. I have called and still not able to get it working properly, it's a major annoyance for me for when I want to send messages or get on the app for friends. I wish they would fix this problem already. I want to stay signed in so idk why it does that.

Good ap, does what it says, but could use some UI improvments. For example, the Dpad registers diagonal inputs of two directions. BUT I wish it would do the same with face buttons (x,o,□,triangle) Also, adjusting what overlay ui buttons are visible in horizontal mode would be a nice setting. And when the phone is vertical, the controller takes up 2/3 of your screen real estate. Wish the screen/controller ratio was adjustable.

Idk what caused it to start behaving like this, but it just stalls on the psn logo or says "something went wrong, try again later". One day I was able to message friends perfectly fine, the next day it completely stops operating as it should. I've uninstalled and reinstalled so many times, and it still fails to work as intended. Very unsatisfied with the current state of the app's service

This is great app, i use it a alot. I only have 1 issues. Push notifications: they do not have a date or time of received on the phone notification bar. Sometimes I didn't clear an alert and it's from days before. Personally love the push notifications on things I've wishlisted go on sale. Don't love that the update could be from a few days ago and I missed it 😕

One day last a couple weeks ago playing Call of Duty zombies everything was fine. The next day when I login to PlayStation Network to check for any new firesales on games, I was going to buy a game using the app on the phone and get it started downloading but whe wouldn't let me log in because I had an invalid password and I did not change it and it still won't let me go back and login. I'm locked out and have been for a few months and I still have around $32 on my account that's useless.

This app went from being bad to absolute trash. For over a month now, I haven't been able to even add items to my shopping cart from the app, or website. The same message pops up every time: "Can't purchase. This item wasn't added to your cart". Never, ever have I had this problem with the Xbox app, or Play store.

It's great you put chat in the main app. Would you please bring back landscape mode. I hate typing with my phone upright. Also it would be nice if there were shortcuts in the app to use with other apps to share links etc. From Google and YouTube like the old app could do. I get tired of trying to copy paste something only to have the app not send a usable link.

App looks better than before, but Party chat through the phone is not functional. Only gives to option to use server only connection, or Auto, except auto doesn't use the best connection, as my data on my phone is more than fast enough to handle the party. Instead, it locks itself up on "connecting" for 5-10 mins before just closing the party and not allowing you to even attempt to join again. Fix this, and it's an easy 5 star tbh

The new store is TERRIBLE. No filtering or sorting of search results. Limited number of results overall, meaning for games with lots of DLC (like the Rocksmith or Rock Band or Dead Or Alive games), you can't even see browse through all the items. And no wishlists? It all looks REALLY nice, but it's borderline functionally useless. Bad change, Sony. And while you're fixing everything you broke with your store, go ahead and add a button to download all of a game's DLC at once, like XBox has, ok?

Works fine for the most part, but downloading video captures, the ONLY reason I downloaded the app in the first place, is currently broken. Every time I try, it waits a few seconds, then says "can't download now, try again later." I've looked all over the internet for solutions but haven't found any. Fix this. Edit: Alright, now captures have just stopped uploading altogether. The console doesn't even attempt to do it anymore.

App needs an overhaul. With the PS5 being incredibly sleek and modern, the app should have the same feel. I use both Xbox and Playstation and I choose Playstation all the time, but when it comes to the app, I prefer the sleek, modern look of the Xbox app. The app works great, dont get me wrong... it just doesnt match the potential that it could have.

Impressed by how thoroughly this app has been trashed. Messaging barely works, and you can't mute a message group without leaving it. All the useful store features have been removed. Aesthetic is attractive, but not when using them is so slow. And it's been right about 2 months since we were all forced to this app, with almost no improvements in that time. Sony can do better, but they're not.

I loved this app! I use to use this app constantly. It's how I communicate when I'm putting together raid teams for Destiny 2. Unfortunately it stopped working a few weeks ago. Keeps saying error and not compatible with my device. I've tried deleting it more than once. I even did a factory reset on my device. Still. Nothing!!! I'm very disappointed and frustrated. I saw that I'm not the only one having this issue. Please fix it...

Super Laggy, rarely get message notifications Edit: it's progressively getting worse. On top of the issues already stated (the lag/slowness of the app has gotten worse) now I am unable to view and download my captures from the app. The audio for the clips play, but the app doesn't respond otherwise. I've not had a single phone that this app has worked properly on. It is trash.

This update was bad. The integration was good idea, but I can't send any messages or see any. I can only receive, but this is not saved. There is nothing I can do. I tried redownloding. I can't start a party. Just lots of work on Sony end. Also, the spying on us for a more "pleasurable experience" is a good way of spying on us....wtfsony this isn't China

When accessing the Playstation Store from the Playstation App, once I click on the "Add Cart" button for an item the "Sign In to Proceed" dialog message appears and I cannot go any further (Note: I have already sign into the PS App prior to). Help with this issue (Note: Please view email that was sent to the developer). Will change rating once this issue is fix. Thanks

When typing, the app slows down to a hult, making it impossible to type until you close and reopen the app. Has been like this for months now with zero fix. Sony should hier better people to make operating systems and apps, because the ps4 operating system is also super buggy, lags, and crashes way too often. All around shame on sony. Have supported since ps1, and they are only getting more and more careless. As long as they get paid right?

Usually works just fine, but for the last week, I haven't been able to refresh recently played games, chats, etc. If I try to leave a party, it gives me an error message and says try again later. I signed out and back in, still no luck. I Uninstaller the app and reinstalled it, but now I can't sign back in. Did the reset password thing and never got the email. Changed the password online, but still can't sign in. I have a Samsung S20 FE.

Not a fan of the update. The playstation store layout is awkward and annoying. I really don't like that the wishlist is gone. I had over 40 games in my wishlist that I was keeping an eye on for when there were deals, right there when I wanted to purchase a game and future games coming out. I have to look up every game, which sounds like I'm being lazy and just complaining, but it was a useful tool. The new store layout is just not good. Just one man's opinion.

This app use to be cool. It would show off your recent trophies to your friends and vise versa. It would display if you or your friends were on PS3, PS4, or VITA at the moment. It even showed what game you or your friends were playing and you could msg them from the app. They would get a text on their app or whatever console they were on. Displayed online or offline status, and the option to even display that info or not. Now it won't even let you login showing some authortication error.

Had high hopes for the new app, but it is absolute trash. The old messages app by itself was better than whatever this mess is. Can no longer see players met, everytime you try to search for a player that's not already your friend, it says "no results found", and combined with the dumpster fire that was the party system update, it makes messaging and parties unbearable. If the goal was to screw things up as much as possible, then congratulations Sony, you nailed it!

Honestly this app is so poorly optimized. It can take over 30 seconds after tapping any button for the app to respond and load. Trying to open your chats? 25 seconds of lag and then it drops down. Click on a specific group? 30 seconds of the chats tab being raised and then jumping into the group. Picture or video in the chat? You will ALWAYS miss the first 10-20 seconds of video as it always starts in the background, and at times won't even come to the forefront. Picturs take 30 seconds too.

Here lately it's been glitching. To go more into what the problem is, it's that when you're scrolling up/down through the game list in store or library, the app starts running real slow and it never used to do this, literally the frames drop dramatically like on old phones, but i have a Note 10+ and no other app does anything like this. I've been with Playstation since the very first Playstation and i would really like to see this fixed, i do a lot of my purchases from my phone.

Decent app, although sometimes starts you at the top of a deals page (for example) after viewing a certain game and hitting back. Minor, but annoying when you're 3/4 way down a long page and have to find your place again. Also, I apparently filled my wishlist, and while trying to clear a bit of space found that many of the games I've already purchased are still taking up wishlist space. Furthermore, I have no way to delete purchased games from the wishlist. Otherwise, pretty happy.

This app is great, but you guys gotta change the Captures system, it was never a good idea to have it automatically upload every video/screenshot taken in the past 14 days, let alone load them at the same time. The app is incredibly slow with that setting enabled and some screenshots and clips don't even process. It should be that nothing uploads to the app until it uploaded manually, by the user. It's nice to see Sony come out with an official app. Unfortunately, it has issues. Connectivity with the PSN seems non-existent aside from status of who is online and who isn't. It doesn't receive messages from console users, and could use swipe functionality to improve speed and fluidity of the app. It also should have notifications to help app users see new messages and requests. The store space of the app is wasted currently, as its just rating the store and seeing an ad. This should be a constantly updated highlight feature to show off current specials and new content available. Otherwise, why bother having it there. Should take full advantage of a Nexus 4 hardware and that of other current smartphones.

I love the app, so I would really appreciate those functions bring fixed, thanks.  And one more thing, it would be awesome to have the notifications pushed to my phone. Much like what Facebook does.
